purpose: Bounded exploratory controls for larger training clouds and all-layer freedom, not a convergence/global/physical-feasibility conclusion.
code_source: canonical current coating-sim core, numerical fixes frozen before the first experiment
initial_design: Original unchanged 89-layer baseline; every run restarts independently from it, not a holdout-selected prior candidate.
design_variable_bounds: Each original nominal thickness times [0.99,1.01]; this is the search domain, not the manufacturing error amplitude and not proof that a wider search domain could not help.
training_optical_grid: Unchanged explicit 600-condition sparse grid from prior baseline, with original physical bounds and explicit strict R<0.03; no additional margin.
full_nominal_grid: All four original windows, 1nm wavelength points, 25 angles from 39 to51 degrees at0.5-degree spacing, 184600 conditions; strict original bounds.
external_candidate_acceptance: Every proposed improved sparse-nominal checkpoint is independently scanned on the complete original nominal grid before it may replace the external qualified incumbent. If it fails, preserve the prior full-grid-feasible candidate; save the raw sparse result and rejection explicitly. This is not an integrated full-grid constrained search.
holdout_selection_policy: No holdout is generated or evaluated until all four solvers and qualified candidates are fixed. Evaluate and report all four seeds/amplitude results; do not choose the best seed using holdout.
holdout_grid: Complete original 184600-condition grid; same explicit coefficients paired between original and every qualified candidate at each error amplitude.
holdout_parallelism: Pure numeric in-process ThreadPoolExecutor, at most4 workers, independent frozen data/prepared caches per audit, BLAS/OpenMP library threads1; no scheduler, network, sockets, remote environment or HPC purchase.
holdout_parallel_validation: After candidate freezing, one identical explicit scenario is independently checked serial and threaded, requiring exact optical summary equality before bulk parallel audits; no speedup claim.
resource_policy: Do not raise or bypass the existing256MiB formal request result-retention limit. Estimated formal sparse request is100.51MiB at32 scenes/all89 variables. Full original-grid nominal audits are separate chunked summary-only acceptance passes, not a covert reduction in requested samples.
additional_expansion: No64-scene or extra-stage retuning in this batch. Any later expansion or quality-budget study is separately predeclared and requires fresh holdout if informed by these holdout outcomes.
interpretation: 25 evaluations/20 iterations are exploration controls, not adequate evidence of convergence. Hypothetical bounded errors are not measured process sigma or production yield; failed controls do not prove physical infeasibility or a TFCalc/HPC speed limit.
